title: A 1.2MB logo displayed at 76 pixels
items: Matchday's welcome screen and hero band both loaded a 1254x1254 logo weighing 1.18MB, to display it in a 76-pixel square. Both now use the 192-pixel icon at 35KB — the same image, 97% less to download.
That single file was roughly four times the weight of every stylesheet and script the page needs before it can render, and it loaded on first visit.
The result badge for a loss showed white text on red at a 2.99:1 contrast ratio, just under the readable minimum. It now uses the same dark ink the win badge already used.

The interface audit that missed both has been extended: it now weighs images against a budget, and reads the markup built in JavaScript rather than only the HTML files — which is where the second copy of the logo was hiding.
